title: Pantheon Opencode
description: Pantheon v2.3.4 is an OpenCode plugin coordinating 8 canonical agents plus on-demand ephemeral workers, with a typed decision router (Jev), 26 curated skills with progressive disclosure, named-behavior overrides, an on-demand agent forge, and a cost-aware skill discovery cascade. OpenCode 2.x only - the V1 contract is removed.
